evicted.text: Gravity is the force that keeps objects on Earth, and it plays a crucial role in our daily lives. Gravity pulls objects toward the center of the Earth, and it is responsible for the motion of planets and stars. Without gravity, objects would float freely in space, and the Earth would not stay in place. Gravity also affects the movement of fluids and gases, and it is the reason why we feel our weight. In short, gravity is a fundamental force that shapes the universe and keeps everything in place.
